method: Generate original 7x6 gravity histories, uniformly from legal nonwinning next actions. At ranks >= minRank and with >=4 originally legal columns, compute q from independently built original winline residual masks. For each unordered root first-action pair (a,c) source-select lexicographically first legal b,d yielding original four-distinct two-round no-early-win q diamond. Freeze all roots/pairs before independent physical minimax. Candidate certificate does NOT imply root first-action equality.
